verses.en: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.pt: Ó Pastor de Israel, inclina teus ouvidos a mim,tu que pastoreias a José como a ovelhas, que habitas entre os querubins, mostra teu brilho,
verses.en_web: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Shoshannim-eduth. Of Asaph. A Psalm.> Give ear, O Keeper of Israel, guiding Joseph like a flock; you who have your seat on the winged ones, let your glory be seen.

verses.en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
verses.pt: Perante Efraim, Benjamim e Manassés, desperta o teu poder, e vem para nos salvar.
verses.en_web: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
verses.en_bbe: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, let your strength be awake from sleep, and come as our salvation.

verses.en: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.pt: Restaura-nos, Deus, e faz brilhar o teu rosto; e assim seremos salvos.
verses.en_web: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.en_bbe: Take us back again, O God; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.

verses.en: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, até quando ficarás irritado contra a oração de teu povo?
verses.en_web: Yahweh God of Armies, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
verses.en_bbe: O Lord God of armies, how long will your wrath be burning against the rest of your people?

verses.en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.pt: Tu os alimentas com pão de lágrimas, e lhes faz beber lágrimas com grande medida.
verses.en_web: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
verses.en_bbe: You have given them the bread of weeping for food; for their drink you have given them sorrow in great measure.

verses.en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.pt: Puseste-nos como a briga de nossos vizinhos, e nossos inimigos zombam de nós.
verses.en_web: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.en_bbe: You make us a cause of war among our neighbours; our haters are laughing at us among themselves.

verses.en: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.pt: Restaura-nos, ó Deus dos exércitos, e faz brilhar o teu rosto; e assim seremos salvos.
verses.en_web: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.en_bbe: Take us back again, O God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.

verses.en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.pt: Tu transportaste tua vinha do Egito, tiraste as nações, e a plantaste.
verses.en_web: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
verses.en_bbe: You took a vine out of Egypt: driving out the nations, and planting it in their land.

verses.en: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.pt: Preparaste um lugar para ela, e a fizeste estender suas raízes, e ela encheu a terra.
verses.en_web: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
verses.en_bbe: You made ready a place for it, so that it might take deep root, and it sent out its branches over all the land.

verses.en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.pt: Os montes foram cobertos pela sombra dela, e seus ramos se tornaram como o dos mais fortes cedros.
verses.en_web: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
verses.en_bbe: The mountains were covered with its shade, and the great trees with its branches.

verses.en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.pt: Ela espalhou seus ramos até o mar, e seus brotos até o rio.
verses.en_web: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.
verses.en_bbe: It sent out its arms to the Sea, and its branches to the River.

verses.en: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.pt: Por que pois quebraste seus muros, de modo que os que passam arrancam seus frutos?
verses.en_web: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
verses.en_bbe: Why are its walls broken down by your hands, so that all who go by may take its fruit?

verses.en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.pt: O porco do campo a destruiu; os animais selvagens a devoraram.
verses.en_web: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
verses.en_bbe: It is uprooted by the pigs from the woods, the beasts of the field get their food from it.

verses.en: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.pt: Ó Deus dos exércitos, volta, te pedimos; olha desde os céus, e vê, e visita esta vinha;
verses.en_web: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
verses.en_bbe: Come back, O God of armies: from heaven let your eyes be turned to this vine, and give your mind to it,

verses.en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.pt: E a videira que tua mão direita plantou; o ramo que fortificaste para ti.
verses.en_web: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
verses.en_bbe: Even to the tree which was planted by your right hand, and to the branch which you made strong for yourself.

verses.en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.pt: Ela está queimada pelo fogo, e cortada; perecem pela repreensão de tua face.
verses.en_web: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
verses.en_bbe: It is burned with fire; it is cut down: they are made waste by the wrath of your face.

verses.en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.pt: Seja tua mão sobre o homem de tua mão direita, sobre o filho do homem a quem fortificaste para ti.
verses.en_web: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
verses.en_bbe: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

verses.en: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.pt: Assim não desviaremos de ti; guarda-nos em vida, e chamaremos o teu nome.
verses.en_web: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
verses.en_bbe: So will we not be turned back from you; keep us in life, and we will give praise to your name.

verses.en: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.pt: SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, restaura-nos; faz brilhar o teu rosto, e assim seremos salvos. Salmo de Asafe, para o regente, conforme “Gitite”:
verses.en_web: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
verses.en_bbe: Take us back, O Lord God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.
